content_en:
# Introducing AlphaProof Code: a breakthrough in verifying complex software at depth

How Google DeepMind researchers built a new agentic framework that formally verified the code of Signalâs cryptographic protocol â long considered to be a grand security challenge

Today, weâre sharing a milestone in software security long considered to be a grand challenge: Google DeepMind researchers guided AI agents to mathematically prove key security properties of the actual code underlying the Signal protocol, the technology that protects billions of private conversations in apps like Signal and Google Messages.

This breakthrough discovery was made using **AlphaProof Code**, **a novel agentic framework for formal verification at unprecedented depth that combines human expertise with AI agents.** Formal verificationâmathematically proving code runs correctly without flawsâis the highest standard of security assurance; however, it is difficult and often labor-intensive.

Our work marks the first time AI has been used to formally verify a widely deployed cryptographic protocol at this depth. It's also the first time the implementation of a widely deployed protocol like this has been formally verified by any method, with or without AI.

## How we verified Signal

AlphaProof Code is a multi-LLM agentic framework that splits the work of formal verification the way a research team would: human experts work with AI to decide *what* to prove, and a group of AI agents does it.

First, our researchers collaborated with a mix of models to translate Signalâs security goals into formal mathematical specifications, with human experts reviewing every one. From there, agents powered by Gemini Carbon did the proofs, generating over six million lines of Lean, a computer language that mathematically proves the accuracy of code.

Next, the agents audited the proof and highlighted areas that needed a second look by a human â just one percent of the codebase, a massive time savings. Because Lean automatically checks the rest, our experts could focus their review where human judgment matters most.

Cryptographic protocols underpin nearly all digital communication, from online banking to web browsing, and a single flaw can expose millions of people at once. That's why experts have spent decades formally analyzing them.

But most protocol verification stops at the design level. Our agents went further, proving that the compiled code fulfills the key security properties â such as keeping messages protected before and after a device is temporarily compromised â down to the exact code running on devices. Because real-world vulnerabilities often hide in the gap between design and implementation, bridging this gap makes these proofs vastly more complex.

Even at this complexity, our verification process took just four weeks â a task that historically takes expert teams years â proving that Signal's core cryptographic code delivers the security protections our experts specified.

To confirm that AlphaProof Code can tell correct code from buggy code, we reintroduced two real, previously fixed bugs into an isolated version of Signal's code. In both cases, the system produced a machine-checked proof that the buggy version was insecure.

While prior formal verification work has necessarily focused on smaller scopes, this new approach enables a significant expansion. Traditionally, verifying that production code strictly matches its cryptographic design required extensive manual effort, making the use of AI agents to automatically translate live code into valid Lean theorems a great breakthrough. As AI-driven security threats grow, having the core Signal protocol rigorously verified with automated theorem proving gives us even greater confidence that our code delivers on its privacy guarantees.

## The future of security

Achieving this long-standing challenge demonstrates how AI can bring elite security assurance to businesses, governments, and critical infrastructure, helping defend against agent-driven cyber threats.

Verifying Signal's core cryptography lays the groundwork to secure other vital systems, from medical device firmware to power grid software.

Scaling these techniques requires continued research. Paired with automated defense agents like CodeMender, formal verification can help counter the speed and scale of modern cyber threats to create software with mathematical proof that its protections work.

We are open-sourcing our formal verification artifacts for community use. Read the technical paper below.

## Acknowledgements

This research was developed by Swarat Chaudhuri, Andrew Ferraiuolo, Anton Kovsharov, Tej Chajed, Sam Schlesinger, Karn Seth, Jonathan Katz, Charles Sutton, and Pushmeet Kohli.

We thank Eric Wieser for help with open-sourcing our code, Owen Jones for program management support, and MartÃn Abadi, Christopher Henson, Katerina Hristova, Henryk Michalewski, Jonathan Protzenko and George Tsoukalas for helpful discussions. We thank Signal's Rolfe Schmidt, Michael Rosenberg, and Ehren Kret for their feedback on our methodology. We also thank Tulsee Doshi, Four Flynn, Kate Olszewska, Alicia Huang, Andy Liu, Benoit Schillings, Raluca Ada Popa, Melvin Johnson, Koray Kavukcuoglu, Demis Hassabis, and Sundar Pichai for their support of the project.
content_zh:
# 推出 AlphaProof Code：深度验证复杂软件的重大突破

Google DeepMind 研究人员如何构建一个新的智能体框架，对 Signal 加密协议的代码进行形式化验证——这长期以来被视为一项重大安全挑战

今天，我们分享软件安全领域一个长期被视为重大挑战的里程碑：Google DeepMind 研究人员引导 AI 智能体，对 Signal 协议底层实际代码的关键安全属性进行了数学证明。Signal 协议是保护 Signal 和 Google Messages 等应用中数十亿私密对话的技术。

这一突破性发现借助 **AlphaProof Code** 完成，**这是一个用于前所未有深度形式化验证的新型智能体框架，将人类专业知识与 AI 智能体相结合。** 形式化验证——用数学方法证明代码运行正确、没有缺陷——是最高标准的安全保障；然而，它难度大，且往往耗费大量人力。

我们的工作标志着 AI 首次被用于如此深度地对一个广泛部署的加密协议进行形式化验证。这也是首次通过任何方法（无论是否使用 AI）对这样一个广泛部署协议的实现进行形式化验证。

## 我们如何验证 Signal

AlphaProof Code 是一个多 LLM 智能体框架，它像研究团队那样拆分形式化验证工作：人类专家与 AI 合作决定*要证明什么*，一组 AI 智能体负责完成证明。

首先，我们的研究人员与多种模型协作，将 Signal 的安全目标转化为形式化数学规范，并由人类专家逐一审查。随后，由 Gemini Carbon 驱动的智能体完成证明，生成了超过六百万行 Lean 代码。Lean 是一种用数学方法证明代码正确性的计算机语言。

接下来，智能体审计了证明，并标出需要人工复核的部分——仅占代码库的百分之一，极大节省了时间。由于 Lean 会自动检查其余部分，我们的专家可以将审查集中在最需要人类判断的地方。

加密协议几乎支撑着所有数字通信，从网上银行到网页浏览，而一个缺陷就可能同时暴露数百万人的信息。这就是专家们花费数十年对其进行形式化分析的原因。

但大多数协议验证止步于设计层面。我们的智能体走得更远，证明编译后的代码满足关键安全属性——例如在设备暂时被攻陷前后都能保护消息——一直深入到设备上运行的确切代码。由于现实世界的漏洞往往隐藏在设计与其实现之间的差距中，弥合这一差距使这些证明的复杂度大幅提升。

即便复杂度如此之高，我们的验证过程仅用了四周——而这项任务历史上需要专家团队花费数年——证明了 Signal 的核心加密代码提供了我们专家所指定的安全保护。

为了确认 AlphaProof Code 能够区分正确代码和有缺陷的代码，我们在 Signal 代码的隔离版本中重新引入了两个此前已修复的真实缺陷。在这两种情况下，系统都生成了机器校验的证明，表明有缺陷的版本是不安全的。

尽管此前的形式化验证工作必然聚焦于较小的范围，但这一新方法实现了显著的扩展。传统上，验证生产代码严格符合其密码学设计需要大量人工投入，因此使用 AI 智能体自动将实际运行的代码转换为有效的 Lean 定理是一项重大突破。随着 AI 驱动的安全威胁不断增长，借助自动定理证明对 Signal 核心协议进行严格验证，让我们更加确信我们的代码能够兑现其隐私保证。

## 安全的未来

攻克这一长期挑战表明，AI 能够为企业、政府和关键基础设施带来顶尖的安全保障，帮助抵御由智能体驱动的网络威胁。

验证 Signal 的核心密码学为保护其他关键系统奠定了基础，从医疗设备固件到电网软件。

推广这些技术需要持续的研究。结合 CodeMender 等自动化防御智能体，形式化验证可以帮助应对现代网络威胁的速度和规模，打造出具有数学证明其防护有效的软件。

我们正在开源我们的形式化验证产物供社区使用。请阅读下方的技术论文。
